ip_address.label: Raumfeld host
ip_address.description: IP address of the device running the Raumfeld host service (a physical Raumfeld device or the Raumfeld app acting as host).

port.label: Raumfeld host port
port.description: Port of the Raumfeld host webservice. Only change this if you run the host on a non-default port.

manifest.description: Stream music to Teufel Raumfeld (Smart Speaker) multiroom devices.

errors.no_host_found: No Raumfeld host found at the given address. Check the IP address and port, and make sure a Raumfeld device or the Raumfeld host app is running.
